text: Introduction The specialty of Material Science and Engineering is the state key discipline. This program is targeted to cultivate advanced talents to undertake research, teaching and engineering technology and management of Material Science and Engineering and also innovative in all those fields with a profound theoretical knowledge, fundamental skills in experimentation and systematical comprehension of the field of Material Science and Engineering. The Teaching team is mainly composed of teachers who possess an experience of studying at top Euramerican universities and have rich experience in how to teach and instruct international students. Some courses are taught by scholars of well-known Euramerican universities. Research Orientation Ecological building materials and its key technology, High-performance metals and engineering, Advanced polymer materials and engineering, New composite materials and engineering, Biomedical Materials and Engineering, New composite material technology, Material molding new technology, Photoelectron and information material, New energy materials and technology. Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree.
